cards.definition: repositório — local onde o código-fonte é armazenado
cards.example_sentence: Clone the repository before making any changes.

cards.definition: commit — registro de alterações no controle de versão
cards.example_sentence: Please write a clear message with each commit.
Create a new branch for each feature you develop.

cards.definition: bug — erro ou falha no software
cards.example_sentence: The bug was introduced in the last commit to the main branch.

cards.definition: consulta — instrução para recuperar dados do banco
cards.example_sentence: This query runs slowly because there is no index on that column.

cards.definition: índice — estrutura que acelera buscas no banco de dados
cards.example_sentence: Adding an index to that column reduced the query time by 90%.

cards.definition: migração — script que altera a estrutura do banco de dados
cards.example_sentence: The migration was rolled back because it broke a foreign key constraint.
We store all backups in an S3 bucket on AWS.

cards.definition: instância — servidor virtual em execução na nuvem
cards.example_sentence: The cloud instance will be scaled up during peak hours.

cards.definition: Terraform — ferramenta de infraestrutura como código
cards.example_sentence: We use Terraform to provision all our cloud infrastructure.
